title: Composter Compatibilities
description: Makes a lot of items compostable! DYNAMICALLY! For any mod.
body:
This is a VERY lightweight and un-invasive mod that makes possible to compost just about any vegetable or food, from ANY mod, by just using item tags, item, properties and even recipes!

Features:

- Any food/vegetable is now compostable (except food that includes meat)
- Drinks (in bottles or in buckets) are now compostable, and the composter will spit out the container after it's done!
- Items made of all compostable items become compostable too!
- Any bone-mealable item/block becomes compostable too.

![Showcase gif](https://i.imgur.com/DoD6lFu.gif)

Tested with:
- Farmer's Delight
- Croptopia
- Various other crops and food mods

If you run into any item that should or shouldn't be compostable, please OPEN AN ISSUE!
